propositions: Prior plan-review findings with empty evidence are injected as hardcoded assertions on every review round, bypassing Pass-2 grounding validation and replaying verbatim even after the plan addresses them.

Recalled findings lose their persisted evidence during injection and re-persist indistinguishably from fresh findings, creating a permanent ratchet where the recall eligibility filter never expires them.
Prior findings must carry their original persisted evidence and impact into the recalled candidate so Pass-2 re-grounds the claim against current plan text instead of validating a bare assertion.
Prior findings with no persisted grounding evidence (the signature of previous recall injections) must be ineligible for recall to break the ratchet retroactively on already-written sidecars.
Recall must be suppressed when the prior sidecar's material_fingerprint differs from current, because finder silence on changed material is evidence the edit resolved the finding, not a miss.
